propositions: The complexity-baseline.json file lacks a CI lock equivalent to the module-size limit lock, allowing any contributor to modify it without administrator override.

The baseline can grow silently by adding new function entries: the test suite validates schema and entry count consistency but does not prevent new entries from being added, creating a loophole where new complexity enters without review.

The CI lock must perform semantic comparison (entry-by-entry) rather than byte-equality comparison to distinguish legitimate shrinkage (removed or lowered entries) from illegitimate growth (raised or added entries).

The module-size lock in _build-and-test.yml fails open on fetch failures with a warning, allowing unverified changes to the limit to pass; the complexity lock and the module-size lock must both fail closed.

Adding a new function above the C901 complexity threshold must fail CI even when a matching baseline entry is added in the same change, closing the loophole where new complexity is admitted by its own baseline entry.
